question: What does the remaining sibling registry factory dispatch 0x6136b40 do -- the FilterPolicy dispatch listed as an open unknown in #4428 and #4453 -- and how does its name lookup 0x6136650 resolve a policy name in the registry? Resolves #4428's open unknown 'the sibling dispatch 0x6136b40..0x613721b' (the second of the two; the first was pinned by #4453).

resolves.answer: 0x6136b40 is the FilterPolicy registry factory dispatch (Status* out, ObjectRegistry* registry, name, shared_ptr<const FilterPolicy>* policy_slot), the same template as #4428's BlockCipher dispatch 0x5ff9fe0 and #4453's SystemClock dispatch 0x5fd4080 instantiated for the 'FilterPolicy' factory type. It resolves the name through the lookup 0x6136650, invokes the matched creator through the factory record's +0x18 invoker, and wraps the returned raw object in a fresh 0x18-byte non-inplace shared_ptr control block (vtable 0x64d37f0, typeinfo for shared_ptr<const rocksdb::FilterPolicy>). Two template differences from the siblings: the lookup inlines the unordered_map find (no call to the map-find helper 0x5fd2980), and the shared tail copies the 16-byte temp Status inline at 0x6136e30 instead of calling the Status move-assign helper 0x5fcdf70.

dispatch_0x6136b40.signature: (Status* out, ObjectRegistry* registry, const std::string& name, shared_ptr<const FilterPolicy>* policy_slot)

outcomes.condition: lookup returns a zeroed record (manager null)
outcomes.note: built into the 0x30(%rsp) temp, then copied into *out by the shared tail at 0x6136e30

outcomes.condition: factory returns null and left the string arg empty (0x88(%rsp) == 0)
outcomes.note: built into the 0x30(%rsp) temp, then copied into *out by the shared tail at 0x6136e30

outcomes.condition: factory returns null but filled the string arg with a message (0x88(%rsp) != 0)
outcomes.note: the factory's string is the msg1 string_view (ptr at 0x40(%rsp), size at 0x48(%rsp)); built into the 0x30(%rsp) temp, then copied into *out by the shared tail at 0x6136e30

outcomes.condition: factory returns non-null but stores nothing in the slot
outcomes.message: Cannot make a shared FilterPolicy from unguarded one : <name>
outcomes.note: built directly into *out (rdi is rbx); the shared tail is not taken; the unguarded object is then destroyed through its vtable slot 1 at 0x6136ce4

outcomes.condition: factory returns non-null and stores the raw object in the slot
outcomes.action: new 0x18-byte control block (vtable 0x64d37f0, counts (1,1) from 0x459b20, object at +0x10); store (object, control) into the out policy slot; release the old policy via 0x5d350c0

dispatch_0x6136b40.record_destroy: after a non-null factory return the record is destroyed via its manager with op 3 (0x6136c42); a no-op for the stateless creator lambdas, as in #4428 and #4453
dispatch_0x6136b40.status_temp: the 16 bytes at 0x30(%rsp) are a Status temp, zeroed to kOk at 0x6136bf7 after the factory call; the dispatch itself writes a non-kOk Status there in the factory-null branches (0x6136f0a, 0x6136f59) and the lookup-miss branch (0x6137021), and the shared tail at 0x6136e30 copies it into *out inline (movzwl/mov/mov, 16 bytes) when its code byte is non-zero. No registered creator writes the temp -- the same answer as #4453 gave for the SystemClock dispatch. Unlike the SystemClock dispatch, whose tail calls the Status move-assign helper 0x5fcdf70 at 0x5fd432c, this dispatch has no call to 0x5fcdf70 anywhere in 0x6136b40..0x613721b.
dispatch_0x6136b40.status_ctor: 0x61cf670(out, code, subcode 0, msg1, msg2, severity 0): msg1 and msg2 are string_views ({ptr, size} pairs at 0x40(%rsp) and 0x50(%rsp)); message is msg1, or msg1 + ': ' + msg2 when msg2 is non-empty

lookup_0x6136650.signature: (FactoryRecord* out, ObjectRegistry* registry, const std::string& name) -> FactoryRecord*

registry_layout.+0x60: parent registry pointer (recursed into on exhaustion)

algorithm: lock the registry mutex at +0x98 (lock failure throws system_error with the errno)
walk the libraries vector backwards, 16-byte elements (first qword = library pointer; second qword unread, open unknown)

per library lock its mutex at +0x00, then query its map for the type name 'FilterPolicy' with an INLINED unordered_map find (no call to 0x5fd2980, unlike the SystemClock/BlockCipher lookups): if the map holds more than 0x14 entries hash it (seed 0xc70f6907, bucket count at +0x30, bucket array at +0x28, chain walk with hash + size + memcmp), else walk the node list linearly from the head at +0x38, comparing the 12-byte key by length then bytes
on a hit walk the entry's candidate vector (+0x28/+0x30) and call each candidate's vtable slot 2 (Matches, forwards to PatternEntry Matches 0x61f8670) with (candidate, name)

on a match clone the factory record (manager op 2, a no-op here, plus the explicit 16-byte copy of the {manager, invoker} pair) into a temp record, then clone the temp into *out when its manager is non-null (0x61367c0) and destroy the temp with manager op 3 (0x6136a15)
on exhaustion unlock and recurse into the parent registry at +0x60; with no parent zero *out
lookup_0x6136650.map_key: FilterPolicy (12 chars, built SSO: movabs 'FilterPo' at 0x61366cd + 'licy' 0x7963696c at 0x61366e0)
lookup_0x6136650.manager_ops_observed: op 2 (clone) at 0x61367a5 and 0x61369f4, op 3 (destroy) at 0x6136a15 are called on the record's manager; both are no-ops for the stateless creator lambdas, as in #4428 and #4453

layout.+0x00: functor storage (16 bytes, zero for stateless lambdas)

factory_record.invoker_signature: (record, name, slot_ptr_ptr, string*) -> raw FilterPolicy* or null; stores the new raw object at *slot_ptr_ptr; may fill the string arg with an error message when returning null
factory_record.factory_slot_protocol: the creator stores the new raw object pointer at the slot (0x28(%rsp) in the dispatch), destroying any previous object there through its vtable slot 1, and returns the same pointer; null return means failure

control_block.typeinfo_note: the pointee is const (IPK...): the out slot is a shared_ptr<const rocksdb::FilterPolicy>, unlike the BlockCipher/SystemClock slots, whose typeinfos name a non-const pointee
control_block.vtable_length_note: 5 function slots plus a trailing zero slot (vtable_len 6), like the BlockCipher control-block vtable 0x64d0198 (#4428). Unlike the SystemClock vtable 0x64cdf38 (#4453), the qword after slot 4 here is a zero slot, not the next .data.rel.ro object.

dispatcher_calls: pthread_once init of the provider registry map 0x6507c78 with init 0x6138a10 at 0x6137457
dispatcher_and_wrapper.dispatcher_note: mirrors #4402's dispatcher 0x5ffa710: pthread_once init, the options-map host call, the dispatch call, and the configure call. Its internals are cited, not pinned here.
dispatcher_and_wrapper.wrapper_gate: if rcx+0x08 == 2 and the string at (%rcx) starts with 'id' (0x6469) and r8+0x08 == 0, it zeroes the shared_ptr at (%r9) (releasing the old policy via 0x5d350c0 at 0x60db021) and returns kOk; otherwise it forwards to the dispatcher at 0x60dafe0

filter_policy_registration.evidence: the only other binary-wide lea sites of 'FilterPolicy' are 0x6138179 (inside 0x6137fe0) and 0x6137b6c (inside the per-factory registrar 0x6137810). 0x6137fe0 is called from the dispatcher's pthread_once init 0x6138a10 (FDE 0x6138a10..0x6138a8b); it registers 'FilterPolicy' via the register helper 0x5fd1da0 at 0x613818f, then calls 0x6137810 three times (0x613825f, 0x6138356, 0x6138450) with names built from literals including ':false' (0x442ac3) and ':true' (0x4384f5) suffixes. 0x6137810 allocates a 0x30-byte record (vtable 0x64d5390 at 0x6137b00) and registers 'FilterPolicy' via 0x5fd1da0 at 0x6137b87.
filter_policy_registration.interpretation: plausibly the builtin FilterPolicy registrations (BloomFilterPolicy-style names with ':false' / ':true' suffixes); the exact creator routines are not pinned here (open unknown)
